name: Lead Qualification & Consultation Flow
description: Collects customer name, service interest, and preferred contact details.

steps.prompt: *Step 1 of 3*: Welcome to *{{business_name}}*! Let's get you set up. What is your *Full Name*?
*Step 2 of 3*: Nice to meet you, *{{name}}*! What specific service, product, or inquiry can we help you with today?
*Step 3 of 3*: Great! Please provide your *Email Address* or *Phone Number* (and preferred contact time) so {{admin_name}} can follow up with you.
